'''Scorcher505 Darth Vader and his amazing friends''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Scorcher505]]
* '''Published:''' 9 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Back Door|Endor-D-endorbackdoor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Back Door
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Endor Back Door Scorcher505 DS DarthVad.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is and Ominous Rumours power deck. I have lots of ground and space power. Please review.

== Strategy ==

The strategy of this deck is to get ominous rumors on the table and drain the life out of the rebels. If the rebels are on the ground, you can chase them down with the stormtroopers w/ Vader and tarkin. Now, before you say "Stormtroopers suck", take a look at their stats:

Deploy: free w/ imperial ability>2

Power: 1 + 2(trooper assault) + 1(major hewex there) + 1(control corlag) = 5

Are immune to attrition

Armor 4

Then there is imperial decree. Control two battleground systems and one battleground site and all opponents force drain bonuses everywhere are ignored!

I have had force drains of over 15 per turn with this deck. With drains that high, the rebels cannot survive long. Tell me what you think.
